title: Physics — The Laws God Wrote: Unit Quiz

questions.question: Newton's First Law of Motion states that an object at rest stays at rest, and an object in motion stays in motion with constant velocity, unless acted upon by what?
questions.explanation: Newton's First Law (the Law of Inertia) states that an object's state of motion changes only when an unbalanced external force acts upon it.

questions.question: According to Newton's Second Law, if you double the net force on an object while keeping its mass constant, what happens to its acceleration?
questions.explanation: F = ma shows that acceleration is directly proportional to force. Doubling the force doubles the acceleration when mass remains constant.

questions.question: The Law of Conservation of Energy states that energy:
options: Can be created but not destroyed
Can be destroyed but not created
Cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed
Increases over time in a closed system
questions.explanation: The Law of Conservation of Energy states that energy cannot be created or destroyed by natural processes — it can only be transformed from one form to another.

questions.question: What type of wave is a sound wave?
questions.explanation: Sound is a longitudinal mechanical wave — compressions and rarefactions of particles in a medium, oscillating parallel to the direction of wave travel.

questions.question: Which scientist demonstrated that a changing magnetic field can induce an electric current in a wire?
questions.explanation: Michael Faraday discovered electromagnetic induction — that a changing magnetic field produces a voltage and current in a conductor. This principle underlies electric generators and transformers.

questions.question: According to Ohm's Law, if a circuit has a voltage of 12V and a resistance of 4Ω, what is the current?
questions.explanation: Ohm's Law states V = IR. Solving for I: I = V/R = 12V / 4Ω = 3 A.

questions.question: When white light passes through a prism, it separates into colors because:
options: The prism adds color to the light
Different wavelengths of light refract by different amounts
The prism absorbs some colors and reflects others
Light changes speed only at the surface of the prism
questions.explanation: White light is a mixture of all visible wavelengths. A prism separates these wavelengths because each one refracts by a slightly different amount (dispersion), producing the visible spectrum.

questions.question: The Doppler effect explains why:
options: Light cannot travel through a vacuum
Sound cannot travel through a vacuum
An ambulance siren sounds higher-pitched as it approaches and lower-pitched as it moves away
All waves travel at the same speed
questions.explanation: The Doppler effect is the change in observed frequency due to relative motion between the source and observer. An approaching source compresses wave crests (higher frequency/pitch), while a receding source stretches them (lower frequency/pitch).

questions.question: Kinetic energy is calculated using the formula KE = ½mv². If you double the velocity of an object, its kinetic energy:
questions.explanation: Because kinetic energy depends on the square of velocity (v²), doubling the velocity quadruples the kinetic energy: ½m(2v)² = ½m(4v²) = 4(½mv²).

questions.question: Which of the following best explains why many early physicists like Newton, Faraday, and Joule saw no conflict between their faith and their science?
options: They kept their faith and science completely separate
They believed that studying nature's laws was a way to understand the mind of the Creator
They did not take their faith seriously
Science had not yet advanced enough to challenge faith
questions.explanation: Scientists like Newton, Faraday, and Joule believed that a rational God created a rational universe with discoverable laws. They saw scientific investigation as a form of worship — thinking God's thoughts after Him.
